assets.prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph for a square 1:1 social ad, an in-use haircare scene in a sunlit bathroom. Reference images: @front shows the exact product, a matte bottle with a white flip-top cap. @back is for reference only. Reproduce the product exactly as in @front: the same shape, proportions, white flip-top cap and colour, with a matte soft-touch finish and the front label facing the camera. Spell the printed words exactly, in the same typefaces and positions: "VERDA", "Daily Hydrating", "Shampoo", "with aloe & oat · 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz". The bottle stands upright in the left third of the foreground on a honey travertine ledge with visible natural pitting. It is in sharp focus, about half the frame height or less, and is photographed in this scene rather than added to it. It casts a soft shadow falling to the right that matches the sunlight, and a true wet reflection shows in the glistening stone. Fine water droplets and a few thin runs of water bead on the bottle and cap, and small water beads sit on the travertine. In the right two thirds, in the mid-ground and slightly soft, a person is seen from behind and to the side, with no face in frame. They wear a thick white cotton towel wrapped high around the shoulders. Their wet hands work soft white lather with fine bubbles through wet, dark hair, massaging it in. The hands are natural and relaxed, with realistic texture, no jewellery, no painted nails and no tattoos. Nothing touches or overlaps the bottle, and the hands and hair stay well clear of the left third. Background: a wall of glazed terracotta zellige tile with slightly uneven, handmade tiles in a rich, saturated, earthy terracotta, clearly contrasting with the sage pack and the honey stone. The wall is softly out of focus but keeps its full colour, with a faint wisp of soft steam in the air. Lighting: hard, warm, low golden-hour sun from a window on the left falls across the bottle and ledge and casts crisp window-pane bar shadows across the tiles. There is a strong difference between lit and shadowed areas, with warm highlights that are never blown out on the label. Camera: level with the ledge at about mid-bottle height and straight on, with only a thin sliver of the ledge top visible and no looking down. 50mm lens at f/2.8, foreground sharp, background soft. Palette: terracotta, honey stone, white cotton and the sage pack, graded warm and full like an editorial magazine photograph. No other products, packaging or text, no faces, no jewellery, no pale beige walls, no flat even light, no washed-out look.
